text:
Zoe: Quick final sync for the 1776 launch. Need changelog URL, docs link, canary timing, perf numbers for slides, and webhook for HubSpot. Who can confirm?

Raj: Changelog live: https://redwood.com/changelog/1776. Note: chat.generate param rename max_tokens -> token_budget. Backcompat via shim for 30d. Docs update ETA EOD.

Emi: We want p50, cost/1k tokens, and caching delta for one slide. Bench numbers by noon?

Paul: Canary deploy set for 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. deploy-bot scheduled job cb-1776-01. I’ll pull perf graphs after canary. Enabling prefix_cache=v2 needs DB flag approval.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for release/1776 -> canary at 2026-04-02T16:00Z (job id: cb-1776-01).

ops-sre: I'll flip the DB flag, ACL webhook creds, and monitor metrics under /releases/1776/metrics. ETA for webhook creds -> 3pm PT to 1Password.

Zoe: @Raj paste a short migration blurb (<120w) for the blog and a one-line quote for PR.

Raj: Blurb: 'We renamed max_tokens to token_budget to clarify limits; upgrade to SDK 2.1+ or use the compat shim for 30 days.' Quote: 'Small API cleanup to simplify client limits, with smooth upgrade paths.'

Emi: I'll reserve webinar slot 3pm PT on release day and draft slides. Need perf png from Paul for slide 3.

Paul: Uploaded perf graphs: https://redwood.com/docs/benchmarks/1776/perf-graphs.png. Adding sample curl for shim to docs.

Zoe: HubSpot mapping: marketing pipeline = product_launch_1776. Ops-sre to create webhook and tag me when secrets live.

ops-sre: Done: webhook created, secret posted to 1Password CI vault, tagged @Zoe. Customer Success: notify top Dedicated tenants about schema bump.

Zoe: Great. Final checklist: blog copy (Raj), hero metrics + images (Paul), slideshow (Emi), webhook (ops-sre), embargo assets to PR by EOD tomorrow. Any blockers?

Paul: None from runtime.

Raj: Docs/changelog updated with migration snippet. Ready for copy edit.

Zoe: Thanks team 389 will assemble release package and share the drive link.
